Name: Female Shane
Author: Ferzli
Description:
[center][b]— Description —[/b][/center]

This mod changes Shane's portraits and sprites. Because the k's Genderbent Dialogue mod alters game data, two versions of the mod had to be created:
The first version changes the portraits and sprites, but also adjusts the position of the wedding dress and sleeping Shane sprites to ensure correct display. It is compatible with the k's Genderbent Dialogue mod.
The second version also changes the portraits and sprites, but leaves the same positions of the wedding dress and sleeping Shane sprites as in Vanilla. For those who want to play without the k's Genderbent Dialogue mod.

[center][b]— Installation Instructions —[/b][/center]

1. Select the desired version of the mod and download it to your mods folder.
2. Unzip the archive containing the mod.
3. If you use a mod manager (Vortex, Stardrop, etc.), enable the mod in the menu.

[center][b]— Requirements —[/b][/center]

1. SMAPI by Pathoschild.
2. Content Patcher by Pathoschild.
3. k's Genderbent Dialogue by knst0 (optional, except for the version of the mod made for it).

If you encounter any issues, please report them in the posts. I hope you enjoy this mod.
